period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Q1-2025 unaudited financial statements; plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used (Solo+OBU basis). Comparative column (31 Dec 2024) reproduces this dataset's existing FY2024 Q4 equity of 3208.10m exactly. EQUITY IS STILL POSITIVE but razor-thin: 939.67m, down from 3208.10m at year-end 2024 -- a decline of 2268.43m in one quarter. NAV per share fell to 0.29 Taka. This is the last quarter before National Bank's balance sheet actually crosses into insolvency (see 2025_Q2.json). Tax line this quarter includes a large deferred-tax CREDIT (a benefit, not an expense): Provision for taxation +48.14m plus Deferred tax (income) of -3917.21m nets to a tax credit of -3869.06m, which is SUBTRACTED as a negative tax expense, meaning PAT (-2259.42m) is a smaller loss than Profit before tax (-6128.48m) -- confirmed via the identity PBT - Tax = -6128.48 - (-3869.06) = -2259.42, matching the printed figure exactly. As in prior quarters, 'Total operating income' and 'Profit before provision' print without their negative sign despite being losses; corrected via the identity chain. Given equity is still (barely) positive this quarter, ROE is left to be computed normally in ratios_timeseries.json; it must be nulled from 2025_Q2 onward. Source PDF was image-only; text obtained via OCR (tesseract, 300dpi).

PBT -6128.48m minus tax credit -3869.06m = -2259.42m, confirmed exactly.
